args.description: pivots on the spot, turning his back to the right for a moment with both arms swinging close to his body, then turns back into the fighting stance. Only the character is drawn: the opponent is invisible, there is no other person in the frame; his hands stay empty, nothing leaves them, no beam, no streak. The character stays at the same place in the frame (the game moves him), always facing right, seen from the side; keep his look, proportions and colours exactly. Only the character is drawn, with what he holds: no glow, no energy, no projectile, no smoke, no dust, no ground, the whole body inside the picture.
args.subject_description: a young man with messy black hair and violet eyes, a long black coat with a ragged violet lining worn open over a dark shirt, black trousers and black boots
args.initial_pose: holding an invisible opponent in front of him with both hands
